tex_contract.environment: Local macOS arm64, 10 contract reads of the prepared resource set

server_images.environment: Linux arm64 VM, dedicated BuildKit builder capped at 1 CPU / 1 GiB RAM; 2 GiB cache GC target
server_images.method: Repeated unchanged bake --load of web, tex and embeddings with ready cache; no package/model downloads in final repeat. Image ls and inspect report different Docker storage measures.

limitations: Local measurements, not a hosting SLA. Initial builds need public downloads. The bounded BuildKit cache can evict artifacts.

verification.deployment: HTTPS, SMTP invitation, CPU search, TeX/TikZ, restart, backup retention and database restore verified; neighbor unchanged
